Theme

Computing & programming · Conversation, family & daily routines

text message noun

also text, SMS, message (on a phone), send a text

modern

Andresian p. 14

nūntius scrīptus

a written message on a phone

Andresian’s phrase, paired with nūntius vōcālis for a voicemail: a message one reads, against one that is heard. Traupman (p. 261) gives nūntius for a message on a computer. To text someone is nūntium (scrīptum) alicui mittere.

Other words

  • litterulae, litterulārum f. pl. — a short note

    noun, first declension, plural · also used · classical · Cic. Att. 12.1.1 (Lewis & Short)

    Cicero’s word for a hasty little letter, which suits a few lines sent from a phone.

Examples

  • hoc litterulārum exarāvī ēgrediēns ē vīllā ante lūcem

    I scribbled this little note as I was leaving the house before dawnCic. Att. 12.1.1

See also voicemail, telephone, message, notification.
